command_argv:
import ast
import json
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

root = Path.cwd()
python_files = [
    'development/backend/settings.py',
    'development/backend/launcher.py',
    'testing/reports/b00/A01-scaffold/smoke_checks.py',
]
for name in python_files:
    ast.parse((root / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=name)
json_files = ['development/frontend/package.json', 'development/frontend/tsconfig.json']
for name in json_files:
    json.loads((root / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
data = yaml.safe_load((root / 'development/ai_settings.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({
    'python_ast_parsed': python_files,
    'json_parsed': json_files,
    'yaml_parsed': 'development/ai_settings.yaml',
    'reader_argv_lengths': {name: len(reader['command']['argv_template']) for name, reader in data['prep']['readers'].items()},
    'reader_attempts': {name: reader['command']['qualification']['attempt'] for name, reader in data['prep']['readers'].items()},
    'pipeline': data['prep']['pipeline'],
    'debug_default': data['ui']['debug_enabled'],
    'history_default': data['paths']['chat_history'],
    'application_imports': False,
    'runtime_or_smoke_execution': False,
    'live_readers': False,
}))
